answer_1.quote: We propose a new natural language to first-order logic translation (NL-FOL translation) task alongside our reasoning dataset. The goal of this task is to translate an NL story S to an FOL story F S.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include truth value predictions (True, False, Unknown) for logical reasoning and FOL formulas for NL-FOL translation.

answer_2.quote: Two metrics are adopted to evaluate NL-FOL translation to capture different aspects of the generation results: 1). Syntactic validity (SynV)... 2). Inference Engine execution accuracy (ExcAcc).

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on the GPT-4 model outputs with wrong truth value predictions.
answer_4.guideline: We categorize errors into: Wrong derivation, Wrong syntactic comprehension, Spurious shortcut.
